resources.string: Hold to start a mode here, and see the active session.
Choose the apps a mode blocks, then hold here to start it. Tap an anchor to end it.
Starting is easy. Ending it takes a tap on one of your anchors.
Turn on Anchor app blocking so modes can block apps.

To block apps during a focus session, Anchor uses an Accessibility service to see which app is on screen and to cover apps you chose to block. It reads app names only, never what is on screen, and nothing leaves your phone. You can turn it off any time in Settings › Accessibility.\n\nIn the next screen, open Installed apps › Anchor app blocking and turn it on.
To end it, tap your phone on one of your anchors.
